verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI lets you sign in with a Google account rather than manage API keys (gh-13), and a paid tier is referenced (gh-24). Hands-on reports show the consumer Gemini Pro subscription grants nothing extra in the CLI; extra usage requires a separate Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise plan (comm-3, comm-19, comm-2). One user's Workspace account was also refused at login (comm-5). missing for 10: first-party docs mapping existing subscription plans to CLI entitlements, support for consumer Gemini subscriptions, reliable sign-in for Workspace accounts, a single unified developer subscription.
